name: 루크
motion_summary: Eternal Return Luke After Service: tousled pale-pink blond hair, sharp amber eyes, black work outfit with yellow details, cleaner's mop weapon from identity. R fires a penetrating bullet from his cleaning tool and physically knocks Luke backward. 12 sequential poses: ready with mop; lift mop horizontally with both hands; slide front hand up shaft; aim mop head forward-right; lean forward and feet brace; orange-white charge at cleaning-tool head; fire ONE compact piercing round to right, fully contained within the cell; torso and mop jerk backward; back foot skids and he leans rearward from recoil; step forward again; lower mop; ready. Not a chainsaw or conventional rifle. Mop shaft and head remain visually recognizable. Warm gold/white muzzle burst and short trail, NO long beam crossing cell border. Expressive sharp eyes and tiny confident mouth.
visual_review: 청소도구 총구 조준과 단발 사격, 뒤로 밀리는 반동이 보입니다. 연한 머리·황금 눈·작업복과 대걸레 형태가 유지됩니다.
